meta.name: Custom STL Template
meta.description: Template for loading your own STL container. Copy this file, update the file path, adjust translation/scale to match your geometry, then set fluid min/max to place fluid inside the container.
how_to_use: 1. Copy this file and rename it (e.g. my_scene.json).
2. Set boundaries[0].file to the path of your STL file (absolute, or relative to this JSON file).
3. Set translation to the center point of your container in simulation space.
4. Set scale to [width, height, depth] in metres (scales the STL from its native unit size).
5. Set fluids[0].min/max to a block of particles INSIDE the container (leave a gap >= spacing from the walls).
6. Adjust forces.gravity direction to match your intended simulation axis.
7. Open the scene in sph.app.app and press Run.
